Seeing how Bethesda and Valve (briefly) introduced paid mods for Skyrim what do you think the chances are they will do the same with Fallout 4? What is your opinion if they do this right from the start? Would you support it/fight it/be indifferent to it?

Personally I am a bit split on this subject. On one side I think the work some modders put into their work should be rewarded somehow, and I am not sure donations work that well. I also believe the impact on the community might be less if they introduce this to a new game.

On the other hand I believe Bethesda and Valve should not bother bringing paid mods back if the same problems which plagued Skyrim still exist. Problems like bad quality control, stolen mods offered for sale and auto updating of mods (to name a few).

Anyway really interested in the communities opinions!
Possibility of Fallout 4 with paid mods
